VisualCardPool.rationale: `=> ModelDb.CardPool<DefectCardPool>()` (HelloWorld.cs:12) selects the card's ART pool, not its generation pool. Presentation.

ctor.rationale: `base(1, CardType.Power, CardRarity.Event, TargetType.Self)` (HelloWorld.cs:14-17) == cost 1 / POWER / EVENT / SELF. No keywords, no CanonicalVars (the power amount is the literal 1).

OnPlay.rationale: `PowerCmd.Apply<HelloWorldPower>(choiceContext, Owner.Creature, 1m, Owner.Creature, this)` (HelloWorld.cs:22) == `PowerCmd.apply(ctx.hooks, ctx.player, HelloWorldPower, 1, applier=ctx.player)`. Presentation, folded in: TriggerAnim (21).

OnUpgrade.issue: `AddKeyword(CardKeyword.Innate)` (HelloWorld.cs:27) maps to `self.innate = True`, which is correct at upgrade level 1. DOWNGRADE IS STICKY: `Card.downgrade` (cards/base.py:150-165) rebuilds by re-running `_init_vars` and re-applying upgrades, and `_init_vars` does not re-seed the flag, so the instance attribute written by `_on_upgrade` survives. C# `DowngradeInternal` rebuilds the whole keyword set from canonical (`_keywords = cardModel.GetKeywordsWithSources(KeywordSources.Local).ToHashSet()`, CardModel.cs:2143). EXECUTED: `py audit/tools/card_probes.py downgrade` lists this card among the 5 of 203 that do not restore. LIVE -- `downgrade()` is reachable from `events/reflections.py:40`, `events/welcome_to_wongos.py:90` (both registered in `events/__init__.py`) and `powers.py:3171` (DampenPower). Same mechanism and same verdict as card/aggression's and card/apparition's OnUpgrade entries (rule 3). The fix is one line: re-seed the flag in `_init_vars`, as card/anointed, card/discovery, card/entropy and card/gold_axe all do. Observable: a downgraded Hello World still starts every combat in the opening hand in the sim; in the game it does not.
